drill.title: TOGAF Practice Drill
drill.intro: Practice questions and mock exams for the TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Foundation exam. Read and tap in silence, or have them read aloud and answer by voice or with the car's steering-wheel buttons. The app scores you, explains the answer and remembers what you missed.
drill.examsText: Like the real Part 1: 40 questions, 60 minutes, pass mark 24. No feedback until the end, then a score by topic and a review of your mistakes with explanations.

lessons.title: TOGAF Foundation Audio
lessons.sub: 12 episodes · 8 lessons, 2 practice exams, a recap podcast and confusable pairs · pauses after each question so you can answer aloud
lessons.drillSub: Answer the 20 practice questions by voice or with the car buttons

episodes.t: The exam and the big picture
episodes.s: Exam format, enterprise, the standard's structure, domains, landscape levels
Stakeholders, views vs viewpoints, ABB vs SBB, deliverables, artifacts
Phases, iteration cycles, scoping, tailoring, versioning
Phase objectives, the shared B–C–D steps, key deliverables

episodes.t: Phases E to H and Requirements
episodes.s: Roadmap, migration, governance, change classes, requirements
Content framework, building blocks, Enterprise Continuum, repository classes
Principles, stakeholders, gap analysis, scenarios, readiness, risk
Governance traits, Architecture Board, conformance levels, 15-question quiz
10 exam-style questions with options, answer pause and explanation
10 more exam-style questions; aim for 14 of 20 across both parts
Two hosts run through the whole syllabus, with a rapid-fire quiz at the end
Transition vs Segment, Reference vs Standards Library, artifacts, E vs F, compliant vs conformant…

episodes.t: One full cycle, told as a story
episodes.s: A utility through Preliminary to Phase H: who sends what, which phase, repository tour, quizzes along the way

say.intro: TOGAF Foundation practice drill. After each question, say number one, two, three, or four, or words from the answer. Say repeat to hear the question again.
say.intro_buttons: TOGAF Foundation practice drill, with car buttons. I will read each option. Press next when you hear the one you want. Press previous to hear the question again.
say.exam_intro: TOGAF Foundation mock exam. Forty questions, sixty minutes, and no feedback until the end. Answer each question by saying number one to four, or words from the answer.
say.exam_intro_buttons: TOGAF Foundation mock exam. Forty questions, sixty minutes, and no feedback until the end. I will read each option. Press next on the one you want, then next again to confirm.
say.exam_pass: That is a pass. The pass mark is twenty-four out of forty.
say.exam_fail: That is below the pass mark of twenty-four out of forty.
say.p2_intro: TOGAF Part 2 mock exam. Eight scenarios, ninety minutes, and no feedback until the end. Each answer earns five, three, one or zero points. Answer by saying number one to four.
say.p2_intro_buttons: TOGAF Part 2 mock exam. Eight scenarios, ninety minutes, and no feedback until the end. Each answer earns five, three, one or zero points. Press next on the option you want, then next again to confirm.
say.p2_practice: TOGAF Part 2 scenario practice. Each answer earns five, three, one or zero points, and you hear why after each scenario. Answer by saying number one to four.
say.p2_practice_buttons: TOGAF Part 2 scenario practice. Each answer earns five, three, one or zero points. Press next on the option you want, then next again to confirm.
